title: Payment by the Guest for Extra Included Miles on a Keyturn Trip Booking
content:
Extra included miles standing on a Keyturn Trip Booking reservation are paid for by the guest who holds that reservation. The price of a mileage top-up is fixed only after the miles it adds stand on the reservation's included-mile record.

The payment posts a single priced line for the mileage purchase to the reservation, dated today, taken from the card held on the trip, and raises the balance owed on the reservation by the amount paid for. The guest then sees the mileage purchase as its own line among the trip's priced lines, separate from the rate, the trip fee and the deposit.

Until the miles the purchase is being priced for stand on that included-mile record, the price of the top-up is not yet fixed.

### Making the call

The purchase is made with `pay_for_mileage_topup_d571ad94`. This is the guest's own tool over the guest's own reservation: the desk unlocks it and hands it over, and it is run by the customer themselves rather than by the agent.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `booking_id` | The reference number of the guest's trip reservation the purchase is posted to, as the desk read it out from the trip booking lookup. | Id class. |
| `customer_id` | The member reference number of the guest making the purchase, as the desk read it out from the member profile lookup. | Id class. |
| `purchase_amount` | The money the mileage purchase costs. | Fixed-format class: USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent, positive because it is money the guest owes. |

`booking_id` and `customer_id` are identifiers of the Id class. `purchase_amount` is the money the purchase costs, in USD.

### Return

The call returns a receipt sentence naming the reference number of the new priced line, the reservation it was posted to and the amount in USD to two decimal places. Receiving that sentence means the line is on the trip and the balance has risen by it; anything else means nothing was posted.
